questions.name: action/0
questions.instructions: Choose the next remaining action the latest intent requests, in the order the user asked for them. previousActions are already planned with their parameters; do not choose them again unless the user asked for a repetition. droppedActions cannot run for lack of a value; do not choose them again. A view change is an action: choose the action that switches to the requested view. Choose done when nothing requested remains.

choices.description: Every requested view change and content edit is already planned, or none was requested. Showing, hiding or arranging widgets needs no action.
A remaining requested view change or content edit cannot be performed with these actions.
calendar-main, currently month: showWeek. Switch to week view Switches it to its week view.

weather-main, currently current: showWeekly. Show the weekly forecast Switches it to its weekly view.
